name: Valkyr's Grip's offhand damage and disarm-duration reduction are native stat auras (#820)
contract: Spell.dbc 807507 ("Valkyr's Grip", SpellFamilyName 33, Passive, self-targeted) effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_OFFHAND_DAMAGE_PCT (122) with EffectBasePoints 30 (amount 31, DieSides 1) — AuraEffect::HandleModOffhandDamagePercent (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:187) is a pure native aura-type registration with no scripted apply/remove logic; Unit::CalculateDamage (Unit.cpp:12731) multiplies offhand white/melee damage by GetTotalAuraMultiplier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_OFFHAND_DAMAGE_PCT) for every unit that carries this aura, matching the tooltip's "increases off-hand Weapon Damage dealt by 31%" with zero server script needed. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD (232) with EffectBasePoints -16 (amount -15) and EffectMiscValue 3 (MECHANIC_DISARM); Unit::ModSpellDuration (Unit.cpp:12144, called from Spell::EffectApplyAura before a debuff's duration is fixed) reads the *recipient's own* SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD aura for the mechanic being applied to them and shrinks that debuff's duration accordingly — i.e. this aura reduces the duration of disarm effects landed on the Sun Cleric who has it, matching the tooltip. Both aura types are generic engine paths already wired into AuraEffect::handleEffects[122] and [232]; the harness has no way to force an external disarm cast onto a fixture without extra positioning/resource setup, so this scenario pins the exact DBC amounts (31 and -15) that those native handlers consume, rather than re-deriving them live.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Offhand damage bonus is exactly 31% (SPELL_AURA_MOD_OFFHAND_DAMAGE_PCT amount)
Disarm duration reduction is exactly -15% (SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD amount)
